evidence_boundary.M10R_firmware: TCYC/CCYC rows, tone RGB=1/Yb=0, five DGamma selector banks, normal YBLEND=(0,32).
evidence_boundary.cross_revision_source: five gamma slots structurally correspond to RGB-common/R/G/B/Yb and Y/Yb are separate luminance paths.
evidence_boundary.patent_architecture: Yb is derived from pre-gamma RGB and gamma-corrected; Ya/Cb/Cr come from gamma-corrected RGB; main Y blends Ya and Yb.
evidence_boundary.not_proven: Exact M10-R ASIC routing, DG table assignment to Yb, blend denominator, rounding and physical signal widths.
